verdict.rationale: Oyster documents its own benefits capability: API endpoints to retrieve an employment's available benefits offerings and to request (provision) benefits for an engagement. It also offers multi-country payroll. However, nothing in the evidence names health insurance specifically or shows enrollment administration, and nothing shows benefit deductions flowing into payroll. Missing for 10: explicit health insurance offering, enrollment management workflow for ops users, benefit deductions synced to payroll, in-depth benefits docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
